title: Index Funds Now Control 52% Of US Stock Assets
hook: Your retirement fund quietly became a corporate power broker.
closing: The funds holding your savings can influence companies without asking how you would vote.
question: Who votes the shares you own?

segments.say: Passive index funds hold 52 percent of US stock assets. Automatic investing concentrated enormous ownership power.
The Big Three hold 22 percent of a typical large company. A few managers now speak for millions of investors.
Vanguard casts 9 percent of major-company shareholder votes. One fund manager can shape corporate decisions.
